title: Copilot Studio: persistent identity (agent accounts) for agents
summary: Held because Microsoft now documents a beta Graph contract for template activation, which the briefing incorrectly reports as undocumented. The admin paths and roadmap facts are supported, but the licensing discussion also needs to acknowledge Microsoft's newer Frontier Public resource-billing documentation.
